system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In June 2019, under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code as then in force, where interest was payable but no rate had been fixed, what annual percentage rate applied? Answer briefly, stating the number.
raw_response: Under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code as in force in June 2019, where interest was payable but no rate had been fixed, the applicable annual percentage rate was 3%.
